profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer en Hexaware Technologies
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a decade's worth of experience in diverse environments, utilizing agile methodologies to drive software development projects from conception to implementation. Proficient in a wide array of programming languages and tools, I have a proven track record of designing, developing, and maintaining complex software systems.

I'm currently pursuing a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, further deepening my expertise and skills in this innovative field. I'm passionate about leveraging AI to solve complex problems and enhance the capabilities of software systems.

positions.locationName: Norfolk City County, Virginia, United States
positions.description:
DevOps practices.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Took an active part in developing unit testing for a technological platform focused in managing credit card accounts for mexican bank Banamex. Projet Leader and Scrum Master for UX development.
Design, and development of JUnit Tests.
Tool & Technology used: JEE, Spring, Spring Web Flow, Eclipse, JUnit, Selenium, Scrum.

positions.title: Softaware Engineer
positions.description:
Took an active part in developing and giving maintenance to a technological platform focused in standardizing the criteria for the registration of bidders and supply of housing throughout the country. Component level detailed design, development and testing.
Tool & Technology used: JEE 5, JSF, JPA, RichFaces, Microsoft SQL Server, Eclipse, Scrum.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

Tools & Technology used: Java, PrimeFaces, JSF, Hibernate, MySQL, IntelliJ IDEA, Scrum Methodology.

positions.title: Java Developer
